verdict.rationale: The sandbox stores data as plain files (readFile/writeFile) and supports mounting S3-compatible buckets (R2, S3, GCS) plus R2-based snapshots, which are standard, non-proprietary formats a user could pull out with normal tooling. However there is no explicit documentation of a bulk 'export all my data' feature or guarantee of full portability/exit path, and community discussion raises open questions about persistence behavior rather than confirming export ease. Missing for 10: an explicit data-export/account-exit feature, documentation of full data portability guarantees, and independent confirmation that users can fully extract and leave without lock-in.
